text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] gpu-prefill-oom detected on inference-prod-3. 5 container restarts in 3m; severity=P1. Impact: some long-context requests failing. Pager: https://pager.company/run/ABC123. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/prefill-oom.

sam: I'm oncall, ack. Paging SRE/ML runtime. Will coordinate mitigations.

maria: seeing a prefetch spike from large-context requests (>>64k tokens) hitting the prefill path. Likely kvcache allocation + prefetch combined causing OOM.

jordan: node metrics -> GPU0 memory jumps to ~100% during prefill window, then `OOM` + container SIGKILL. Hotpool nodes 4/12 restarted. Suggest immediate: throttle prefill max tokens for prod-3 and trim KV cache aggressively.

sam: rolling policy change now: applying short-term throttle to drop prefill requests >16k tokens for hosted tier. Command: `redctl route update --pool inference-prod-3 --prefill-max-tokens 16000` (running).

liu: notifying customer contact for tenant XYZ. Carol, do you want a brief note?

carol: yes please — they reported 502s and timeouts, want ETA and mitigation steps. I'll hold message template.

maria: attaching compact logs: ```
2026-02-14T02:10:12Z worker[pid=3423] PrefillStart req=abc123 tokens=78000
CUDA: out of memory when allocating 4.2GiB (GPU 0)
Container restart triggered by SIGKILL
```

jordan: quick mitigation executed: triggered KV trim on hotpool and set aggressive eviction threshold. Pushing a rolling restart to pick trimmed state. Pseudo-command run: `kubectl exec -n inference hotpool-ctl -- trim-kvcache --threshold 0.6`

sam: throttle applied, hotpool rolling restart started (4/12 -> restarting sequentially). Also enabling fallback routing to quantized coldmodel for requests over 32k to avoid OOM while preserving service.

incident-bot: On-call handoff reminder: sam -> maria in 30m. Use #incidents for live updates and escalate if customer impact expands.

maria: kicked off scaled coldmodel q4a instances as fallback and enabled streaming prefill so large requests can be serviced progressively. Monitoring GPU memory and restart count.

liu: customer update draft sent to Carol: "We're seeing memory saturation on prefill for very large contexts; we've throttled >16k tokens and routed heavier requests to a quantized fallback. We're monitoring and expect reduced errors within 15-30m."

carol: sending now. Customer asked for estimated resolution <1h. I'll stay on the thread for any new impact.

sam: monitoring — current restart rate dropped to 0.3/min after throttle + eviction. Will post next update in 10m. :thumbsup:
